_readme: Every guideline the AI may cite. scripts/ingest.ts reads the files listed here from this folder. The files themselves are NOT committed (they are copyrighted); run `npm run fetch:guidelines` for the NKF pages and download the PDFs by hand (see README.md in this folder). 'pages' limits a PDF to its diet and nutrition sections; leave it out to read the whole file.

sources.title: KDOQI Clinical Practice Guideline for Nutrition in CKD: 2020 Update (Ikizler et al., AJKD 2020)
sources.pages_note: Guideline 2 (medical nutrition therapy), 3 (protein, energy, dietary patterns) and 6 (acid load, calcium, phosphorus, potassium, sodium). PDF page = printed S-page.

sources.title: KDIGO 2024 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Management of CKD (diet and nutrition sections)
sources.pages_note: 3.2 Lifestyle, 3.3 Diet (protein, sodium), 3.11.5 hyperkalemia dietary considerations, Figure 45 herbal remedies and supplements.

SELF Principle: The Kidney Guide v2 (Dr. Sean Hashmi, MD, nephrologist): supplements and eating pattern
sources.pages_note: Page 9 supplements (high-dose vitamin C, aristolochic acid in some herbal blends, potassium salt substitutes in CKD 3+). Page 10 the Mediterranean-style eating pattern (berries, whole grains, legumes and plant protein, olive oil, fish, nuts in small handfuls; limit ultra-processed food, processed meat, sugary drinks, added salt). Written for general kidney health: it says to ask the doctor first about potassium if you have CKD. Page 11 (habits) is left out on purpose: 'drink to thirst' does not apply to people with a dialysis fluid limit. Free download from Dr. Hashmi's newsletter; the PDF is not committed.
